profile.description: Large active three-day classic-car festival drawing 600+ rodders and enthusiasts, but the organizer said it does not have vendors at the show.

notes.subject: Organizer says no vendors; clarify only if entertainment partnership is materially different
notes.body: Roni Wisdom replied Aug. 9, 2026 that Early Iron Festival does not have vendors at its show. Current Visit Alamosa information confirms the festival is active Sept. 4-6, 2026 and draws 600+ rodders and car enthusiasts. This may have been a vendor-category mismatch, but do not keep re-pitching unless a verified organizer confirms a separate staffed entertainment attraction would be considered outside normal vendor participation.
